spec.description: Almost all internal Prometheus metrics

spec.title: Pool Syncs
spec.description: Average number syncs executed on scrape pools between all jobs.

spec.title: Cache Force Flushes
spec.description: How many times a scrape cache was flushed due to getting big while scrapes are failing.

spec.title: Targets per Job
spec.description: Current number of targets in this scrape pool.

spec.title: Targets
spec.description: Number of scrape pool targets.

spec.title: ZK Watchers
spec.description: The current number of Zookeeper-treecache watcher goroutines.

spec.title: Metadata Cache
spec.description: Metric metadata in the cache for target scraping.

spec.title: Body Size Limit Hits
spec.description: Total number of scrapes that hit the body size limit

spec.title: Sample Limit Hits
spec.description: Total number of scrapes that hit the sample limit and were rejected.

spec.title: Exemplars Out of Order
spec.description: Total number of exemplar rejected due to not being out of the expected order.

spec.title: Duplicate Rejected
spec.description: Total number of samples rejected due to duplicate timestamps but different values.

spec.title: Samples Out of Bounds
spec.description: Total number of samples rejected due to timestamp falling outside of the time bounds.

spec.title: Samples Out of Order
spec.description: Total number of samples rejected due to not being out of the expected order.

spec.title: Target Sync Failure
spec.description: Total number of target sync failures.

spec.title: Data Blocks
spec.description: Number of currently loaded data blocks

spec.title: Checkpoint Create Failures
spec.description: Total number of checkpoint creations that failed.

spec.title: Checkpoints Created
spec.description: Total number of checkpoint creations attempted.

spec.title: Checkpoint Del Failures
spec.description: Total number of checkpoint deletions that failed.

spec.title: Checkpoints Deleted
spec.description: Total number of checkpoint deletions attempted.

spec.title: TSDB Clean Start
spec.description: Lockfile state from previous execution: CLEAN (no lockfile), REPLACED (lockfile replaced), DISABLED (lockfile disabled).

spec.title: Sync Interval
spec.description: Actual interval to sync the scrape pool.

spec.title: Failed
spec.description: Total number of compactions that failed for the partition.

spec.title: Skipped
spec.description: Total number of skipped compactions due to disabled auto compaction.

spec.title: Executed
spec.description: Total number of compactions that were executed for the partition.

spec.title: Triggered
spec.description: Total number of triggered compactions for the partition.

spec.title: Replay Time
spec.description: Time taken to replay the data on disk.

spec.title: Active Appenders
spec.description: Number of currently active appender transactions.

spec.title: Chunks in Head
spec.description: Total number of chunks in the head block.

spec.title: Chunks Churn
spec.description: Total number of chunks created/removed in the head

spec.title: Time Bounds
spec.description: Minumum and maximum timestamp of the head block.

spec.title: Samples Out of Order
spec.description: Total number of appended out of order samples.

spec.title: Series Not Found
spec.description: Total number of requests for series that were not found.

spec.title: Failed Truncations
spec.description: Total number of head truncations that failed.

spec.title: Samples Appended
spec.description: Total number of appended samples.

spec.title: # of Series
spec.description: Total number of series in the head block.

spec.title: Series Churn
spec.description: Total number of series created/removed in the head

spec.title: Truncations
spec.description: Total number of head truncations attempted.

spec.title: Oldest Value
spec.description: Oldest timestamp value stored in the database.

spec.title: MMap Corruptions
spec.description: Total number of memory-mapped chunk corruptions.

spec.title: Snapshot Replay Errors
spec.description: Total number snapshot replays that failed.

spec.title: Reload Failures
spec.description: Number of times the database failed to reloadBlocks block data from disk.

spec.title: Samples Out of Time
spec.description: Total number of out of order samples ingestion failed attempts with out of support enabled, but sample outside of time window.

spec.title: Time Retention Hits
spec.description: The number of times that blocks were deleted because the maximum time limit was exceeded.

spec.title: Size Retention Hits
spec.description: The number of times that blocks were deleted because the maximum number of bytes was exceeded.

spec.title: Size Retention Limit
spec.description: Max number of bytes to be retained in the tsdb blocks.

spec.title: Local Storage
spec.description: The number of bytes that are currently used for local storage by all blocks.

spec.title: Symbol Table RAM
spec.description: Size of symbol table in memory for loaded blocks

spec.title: Vertical Compactions
spec.description: Total number of compactions done on overlapping blocks.

spec.title: Prometheus CPU Usage %
spec.description: Total user and system CPU time of Prometheus process.

spec.title: Prometheus RAM Usage
spec.description: Resident memory size of Prometheus process

spec.title: Rule Execution Time
spec.description: The duration for a rule to execute.

spec.title: Rule Group Evaluation Time
spec.description: The duration of rule group evaluations.

spec.title: Local Storage
spec.description: The number of bytes that are currently used for local storage by all blocks.

spec.title: Active Alertmanagers
spec.description: The number of alertmanagers discovered and active.

spec.title: Sent Alerts [10m]
spec.description: Total number of alerts sent.

spec.title: Page Completion/Flush Rate
spec.description: Page completion/flush rate.

spec.title: WAL fsync Duration
spec.description: Duration (p99) of write log fsync.

spec.title: Corruptions
spec.description: Total number of WAL corruptions.

spec.title: Failed Truncations
spec.description: Total number of write log truncations that failed.

spec.title: Failed Writes
spec.description: Total number of write log writes that failed.

spec.title: Truncations
spec.description: Total number of write log truncations attempted.

spec.title: Watcher Records Failed
spec.description: Number of records read by the WAL watcher that resulted in an error when decoding.

spec.title: File Descriptors
spec.description: Number of open file descriptors.

spec.title: CPU Usage %
spec.description: Total user and system CPU time.

spec.title: RAM Usage
spec.description: Resident memory size.

spec.title: Configuration Reload
spec.description: Whether the last configuration reload attempt was successful.

spec.title: Configuration Reload Time
spec.description: Last successful configuration reload.

spec.title: Active Queries
spec.description: The current number of queries being executed or waiting.

spec.title: Query Log
spec.description:
State of the query log.
https://prometheus.io/docs/guides/query-log/

spec.title: Log Failures
spec.description: The number of query log failures.

spec.title: Active Alertmanagers
spec.description: The number of alertmanagers discovered and active.

spec.title: Dropped Alerts
spec.description: Alerts dropped due to errors when sending to Alertmanager.

spec.title: Alert Errors
spec.description: Errors sending alert notifications.

spec.title: Notification Queue
spec.description: The number of alert notifications in the queue.

spec.title: Sent Alerts [10m]
spec.description: Total number of alerts sent in 10 minutes periods.

spec.title: Prometheus Ready
spec.description: Whether Prometheus startup was fully completed and the server is ready for normal operation.

spec.title: File SD mtime
spec.description: Modification time of files for File Service Discovery.

spec.title: SD Latency (p99)
spec.description: The duration (99th percentile) of Service Discovery scan/query/fetch requests.

spec.title: DNS-SD Lookups
spec.description: The number of DNS-SD lookups.

spec.title: Rule Execution
spec.description: The maximum p99 duration for a rule to execute.

spec.title: Rule Group Evaluation
spec.description: The maximum p99 duration of rule group evaluations.

spec.title: Compaction Duration
spec.description: Duration of compaction runs

spec.title: Tombstone Cleanup Duration
spec.description: The time taken to recompact blocks to remove tombstones.

spec.title: Compaction Chunk Size
spec.description: Final size of chunks on their first compaction

spec.title: Compaction Chunk Samples
spec.description: Final number of samples on their first compaction

spec.title: Compaction Chunk Time Range
spec.description: Final time range of chunks on their first compaction

spec.title: Samples Rate
spec.description: Samples incoming/sent to Remote Storage

spec.title: Send Batch Duration
spec.description: Duration of send calls to the remote storage.

spec.title: Appender Lag
spec.description: Highest timestamp that has come into the remote storage via the Appender interface.

spec.title: Remote Sent Rate
spec.description: The total number of bytes of data (not metadata) sent by the queue after compression. Note that when exemplars over remote write is enabled the exemplars included in a remote write request count towards this metric.

spec.title: Template Expansions
spec.description: The total number of template text expansions.

spec.title: Template Failures
spec.description: The total number of template text expansion failures.

spec.title: Prometheus All Metrics
